notes.title: Rainbow Run Update!
notes.notes:
[BUG FIXES]
- Fixed a bug where the UI would not properly scale to certain resolutions.
- Fixed multiple off-centered cubes on Level 16.

[CHANGES]
On Level 8, moved a difficult coin to an easier location.
On Level 9, removed a fast-moving red block to make the pathway to a coin easier.
On Level 10, removed 4 fast-moving red blocks to make pathways to coins easier.
On Level 13, removed 2 red cubes to improve timings.
On Level 20, added lights for visibility to drastically reduce difficulty.

[NEW CONTENT]
The Rainbow Run "FREE Expansion Pack" is being worked on. Anyone who owns the game will be able
to download it and play it for free!

The expansion pack will contain an extra 10 levels that scale in difficulty. These levels will
feature a completely new set of cubes with new effects. It will be a whole new experience from
the original game!

The release date for the expansion pack has not yet been set.
